text: AI systems that turn classical Islamic legal texts into structured and searchable knowledge for the Legal Knowledge Platform. I work across the whole cycle, from data and experiments to evaluation and integration.
Validated and deployed object detection models for client pipelines. Built the annotated image and video datasets behind them and tracked down annotation errors and edge cases.
Selected through a competitive assessment; four end-to-end capstone projects.
Medical imaging, driver safety and agriculture. Four of the six explain their predictions with Grad-CAM or other explainable AI.
CGPA 3.60 / 4.00, five times on the Dean’s List and once on the Vice Chancellor’s List. Thesis: brain tumour detection with YOLOv10, hybrid CNNs and explainable AI.
